You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How many pounds of potato salad does Ted the T-Rex need to bring to feed everyone at the dinosaur picnic? An adult dinosaur will eat 10 pounds of potato salad. A child dinosaur will eat half as much potato salad as an adult dinosaur. There will be 20 adult dinosaurs and 5 child dinosaurs at the picnic.
